about: How VisuaLex identifies and writes legal sources. Specification: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-04-source-convention-design.md. Each expected value carries a status: decided (the owner's words exist), current (what the code does today, kept), proposed (Claude's low-impact call, stated in the spec), open:Qn (waits for question n of the spec, section 9). Act headings follow the dossier spec the owner approved on 4 October 2026 (2026-10-04-dossier-per-atto-design.md §2, interview Q6): the name for the acts cited by their own name, the act citation for every other act; the names are the dossier's own table (dossierLayout.ts CODE_NAMES), verbatim. The owner took every recommendation on 4 October 2026 («per il 31 procedi con le raccomandazione»): no case of that spec is open. The courts of the Union (the Court of Justice and the General Court) follow questions Q10–Q14 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-decisions-mcp-and-eu-courts-design.md §8, every recommendation taken by the owner on 12 October 2026 («continuiamo», relayed by the orchestrator).

decision_citations_in_text.note: Decisions cited inside a running text, with where they are written: the sentence, the court of the text it is read in when the scanner is told one (within), and the spans it finds (start and end are UTF-16 offsets of the sentence, text the words between them, then the reference and the address). A citation is linked only when its court is written in it; the context rules (the owner, 13 October 2026) are two: inside a Cassazione decision a section written without the court (Sez. U, Sez. 3, S.U.) reads as the Cassazione, and inside a Corte costituzionale decision a kind of decision and its number (sentenza n. 207 del 2018, sentenze n. 253 del 2009 e n. 12 del 2010) reads as the Court's own, unless another court is written right before or after it; no other court has such a rule. A bare number, an act's citation, a court the app cannot open and prose between a court and a number give no span. status decided: what D1 and D2 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-decision-citations-in-texts-design.md settle; proposed: where a span ends and which words may stand inside it. The words are read by the same parser as decision_citations (decisionCitationParser.ts); the scan is the web app's alone (utils/decisionCitationMatcher.ts), there is no Python twin. today is the reader's clock.
